embed.title: !userlist (admin)
embed.description: List registered users, channels, groups and webhooks, with their IDs, areas and status — for auditing, and for finding IDs for `{{prefix}}enable` / `{{prefix}}disable`.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}userlist` — everything registered
`{{prefix}}userlist discord user` — only Discord users
`{{prefix}}userlist telegram group disabled` — Telegram groups that are stopped or disabled

Filters are plain words and can be combined:
• platform: `discord`, `telegram`
• kind: `user`, `channel`, `group`, `webhook`
• status: `enabled`, `disabled` (`disabled` includes stopped)

fields.name: Output
fields.value:
One line each: `type • name | (ID) [areas] status`. The areas are those of the active profile. Status is 🛑stopped (paused with `{{prefix}}stop`), ⛔disabled (by an admin or the bot), both, or blank when active. Webhooks show just their name. Long lists come as several messages.

Telegram community admins can run it too, and see only members of their own communities.
